name: ecorpin-sdk-monorepo
description: Ecorpin internal Service SDK Framework monorepo (@ecorpin/core, @ecorpin/server, @ecorpin/client)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/core && npm run build --workspace=packages/server --workspace=packages/client --workspace=examples/pilot-consumer --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.release: npm run build && npm test && changeset publish
